purpose: Future UI/API strategy visibility filter. This configuration controls display/selection only and must never mutate canonical eligibility.
global_odds_cap_policy: NONE. Odds limits belong to individual strategies only.
guardrails: Changing a UI odds filter never changes strategy eligibility.
R1/R2 retain their locked 1.20 <= odds < 2.10 rule regardless of UI filter settings.
A future strategy may use odds above 3.00, 4.00 or higher if separately validated.
WATCH and discovery rows never become canonical exposure through display filters.
